**Product Quality & Customer Support Failure**

### 2. Main problem in one sentence

### 3. Three practical actions
*   **Improve Technical Documentation:** Clearly list all hardware requirements (e.g., T&L accelerator cards) and known compatibility issues (e.g., OS service packs) on product packaging and digital storefronts to prevent incompatible purchases.
*   **Overhaul Support Response Protocols:** Implement a mandatory response-time SLA for support tickets and ensure that "dead-end" support channels (busy phone lines, unmonitored emails) are replaced with functional, tracked ticketing systems.
*   **Proactive Patch Management:** Ensure software patches are thoroughly tested before release and provide automated, in-app update notifications so users do not have to manually hunt for fixes to make products functional.

### 4. Expected benefit in one sentence
Reducing technical friction and improving support responsiveness will decrease product returns, mitigate customer frustration, and restore brand trust.

Improving product stability and descriptive accuracy will reduce return rates, mitigate negative brand sentiment, and increase customer satisfaction by aligning the final product with advertised expectations.
